findings.label: DatePicker theming inconsistency
findings.detail: ServiceInfoDialog.xaml sets DatePickerControl Foreground=#0F1117 with Background=OwcSurfaceBrush (#252A36); WPF's default DatePickerTextBox does not reliably inherit the control-level background, so the entered date likely renders as near-black text on the default white edit box, visually inconsistent with the sibling dark OwcTextBox inputs. Legible, so not blocking. Consider styling the DatePicker textbox or using a light foreground.
